newsitem.title: JAPAN: Sumitomo Electric seen posting higher profit-paper.
newsitem.headline: Sumitomo Electric seen posting higher profit-paper.

text.p: Sumitomo Electric Industries Ltd is expected to post a parent current profit of about 33 billion yen in the year to March 31, 1997, up 15 percent from a year ago, a Japanese newspaper said on Wednesday.
The Nihon Keizai Shimbun said the expected rise was due to a jump in profits in the firm's information equipment business, helped by booming sales of optical fibres and products for cellular phones.
The newspaper's estimate is about one billion yen higher than the company's profit forecast.
A company spokesman declined to comment on the report.
